data.summary: Phase 1 is written, but nothing has been run: I couldn't run `npm test` or `npm run build`, and I didn't check that the `@/components` import alias resolves. It adds semantic CSS-variable tokens with light and dark themes, Tailwind `darkMode: 'class'`, a tested theme utility, four UI primitives, a new sticky header, KPI-card Summary, skeleton loading and a restyled modal shell. I did not add clsx, tailwind-merge or class-variance-authority, because I can't run npm install and an unlocked dependency would break the build. `cn` is a small dependency-free join helper and the Button and Badge variants are plain lookup maps. Chart components, services and existing tests are untouched.

changedFiles.purpose: Theme storage, resolve and apply functions
darkMode class, token colors, Inter font, fadeIn animation
No-flash theme script, token body classes, theme-color meta
Sticky header, single links array, accessible mobile menu, theme toggle
Skeleton loading, removed console.log, light surface around Details
Dialog role, Escape close, scroll lock, blur backdrop, animation
Light restyle with accessible close button

testsAdded.description: getStoredTheme, resolveTheme and applyTheme with fake storage and root, including invalid values and storage errors

selfVerification.notes: No command execution available, so tests and build were not run. theme.test.js uses only node:test and local modules, so it should run under the existing runner.

followUps: Add clsx, tailwind-merge and class-variance-authority with a lockfile update when npm is available, then swap in the real implementations in cn.js and the primitives.
Dark mode for the chart modals and the Details list in a later phase. They stay on a light-only surface for now: BaseModal and Home's Details wrapper use fixed light colors.
Inter is declared in the font stack only, not self-hosted or loaded.
